subject: change of default options when changing another option

messages.author: 283eace965c099f4
messages.subject: change of default options when changing another option
parts:
Hi, I am not sure whether my subject make sense but here is something
I find pretty confusing about ggplot2. Why are the default options
changed for certain elements when I change other related options? The
best way to clarify what I mean is an example. Why does the color of
the legend key rect border and fill change when I just want to change
the size of the legend key rect? This problem (or is it a feature)
occurs all the time. I think ggplot2 should only change the option I
actually want to change. Otherwise, I end up trying to figure out what
the default colors are so that I can only change the option I want.

Thanks,
Greg

ps: sorry if this is discussed elsewhere. I just didn't know what to
search for...


require(ggplot2)
# simulate data
x=rnorm(100)
y=rnorm(100)
k=factor(rbinom(100,1,0.5))

# plot
g =ggplot(data.frame(x,y,k),aes(x=x,y=y,color=k)) + geom_point()
g
# now I want to change the size of the legend key border
g + opts(legend.key=theme_rect(size=0.2))
# AND the color of the legend key border and fill changes too...

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: change of default options when changing another option
parts:
It's because of the theme elements are specified. We're discussing
how to improve this on the ggplot2-dev mailing list.

Hadley
